# SEO With Siva

> C. Sivaraj is an SEO Analyst and AEO/GEO (Answer Engine Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization) specialist based in Coimbatore, India, with 5+ years of experience driving organic growth for large-scale platforms through enterprise SEO, technical SEO, and AI search optimization.

## About

- [About C. Sivaraj](https://www.seowithsiva.com/about/): Background, experience, education, and certifications.
- Currently SEO Analyst at Orane Healthcare India Pvt Ltd (iCliniq), Coimbatore (Jul 2022-Present), owning SEO and GEO/AEO strategy end to end across a 70,000+ page international medical platform, with 40%+ of organic traffic from outside India.
- Previously SEO Executive at Boostability India, Coimbatore (Sep 2019-Jan 2021), running technical and content audits across 25+ client websites spanning healthcare, SaaS, and services.
- Key results: 1,050% organic session lift from a GEO/AEO pilot, 1M+ Bing AI citations, 12M+ Google generative-AI citations, 70,000+ pages optimized at scale.
- Certifications: Enterprise Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) from seoClarity; Generative Engine Content Optimization from Edureka; GA4 Mastery from Optimize Smart.
- Education: MBA in Marketing, Kongu Engineering College; BSc Computer Science, SNR Sons College.

## Services

- [Home](https://www.seowithsiva.com/): AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO), Enterprise SEO, Technical SEO, Content Strategy, Semantic & Entity SEO, Analytics & Reporting.
- [Contact](https://www.seowithsiva.com/contact/): SEO, AEO, and AI search consulting. Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India; serving clients worldwide remotely.
